abilities.name: Attack
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: Convention: every class ships a free rank-1 Attack. The only weapon strike a Necromancer has, hence the only ability_melee icon in the file.

abilities.name: Crypt Swarm
abilities.description: Deals Shadow damage to the target. Generates 20 Life Force.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Pull with Crypt Swarm, a channel that builds RP while ticking Plague damage'. The engine of all three rotations, so it is the level-1 free builder and the biggest Life Force source in the kit. Deliberately weaker per cast than Lichfrost - you are paid in fuel.
_tuning: 15 Nov 2026, class pass: x0.75. A FREE builder (0 life force, generates it) hitting at a full nuke's value with no resource gate - Mage pays mana for the same number and runs dry; Rogue's builder is energy-gated. Every Necromancer spec needed a 0.4-0.6 damage aura to sit at parity.
21 Nov 2026: a quick cast for the turn timeline (tools/build_cast_speeds.py), sized 0.65x for 0.85x the cost
21 Nov 2026: re-sized for the quarter-mark speeds (Kyle: "Instant should lift .25 of the bar max"): instant is now 0.25 of the meter against medium's 0.75 (tools/build_cast_speeds.py)

23 Nov 2026: a short cast, not instant, re-sized from the instant size to the short one (Kyle: "We should not have damage skills that are low mana with no cooldown being instant"; tools/build_cast_speeds.py no_spam_instants)

abilities.name: Lichfrost
abilities.description: A lance of grave-cold that leaves the target slow and stiff.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Open at range with Lichfrost (builder, generates Runic Power, slows)'. Shared by all three specs - the class tree spends points on it (Lich Essence, Living Dead, Winds of Northrend). mage_frostbolt's curve. The slow is not modelled: a haste debuff on an enemy is read by nothing in Monster, which only folds armor and attack_power off its status effects.
_tuning: 15 Nov 2026, class pass: x0.75. A FREE builder (0 life force, generates it) hitting at a full nuke's value with no resource gate - Mage pays mana for the same number and runs dry; Rogue's builder is energy-gated. Every Necromancer spec needed a 0.4-0.6 damage aura to sit at parity.

abilities.name: Flesh to Worms
abilities.description: Deals Shadow damage to the target over time for 4 turns. Generates 15 Life Force.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Disease an enemy, dealing shadow SP Plague damage and generating Runic Power every 3 sec for 18 seconds'. warlock_corruption's DoT curve. Plague is not a school here, and CoA's own wording is 'shadow SP Plague damage', so every disease in this file is Shadow.
_tuning: 15 Nov 2026, class pass: a top rank at 60 added - its last rank came at 53, leaving it standing still while the world grows ~30% (Classic's main buttons rank at 56-60). tools/add_top_ranks.py

abilities.name: Glacial Tap
abilities.description: Restores life force to you.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Tap into necrotic energies, instantly regenerating 30 Runic Power'. Life Force has no engine regen at all (see module docstring), so this is the only way to refill the pool without casting a builder. mana_restore_pct is the existing rank field for 'percent of max resource restored' - 30 of a 100 pool is 30.

abilities.name: Corpse Explosion
abilities.description: Deals Shadow damage to up to 4 targets.
abilities._source: CoA class tree spends a point on it (Corpse Commander: 'Reduces the Runic Power cost of Corpse Explosion by -20'), so it is baseline kit. enemy_aoe, not is_aoe: target_type is the only field the engine's AoE branch reads, and max_targets caps the cleave at 4.
_tuning: 15 Nov 2026, class pass: ranks put on the authored line (they ran 1.36x steeper than it, biggest single-rank jump 1.10x); overall size kept. tools/fix_rank_lines.py

abilities.name: Death's Due
abilities.description: Removes 1 magic effect from the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Force a target to accept the reality of death, removing any invulnerability or immunity effects from them'. An enemy purge - the same shape as shaman_purge and stormbringer_razorwind. The 5-second curse and its below-20% payoff have no hook and are dropped.

abilities.name: Anti-Magic Shell
abilities.description: Magic damage taken -25% for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Anti-Magic Shell raises every summon with a magic-absorb bubble'. NOTE the convention trap: magic_damage_taken_pct from a BUFF is percent POINTS (divided by 100 in Character.take_damage) while the TALENT form of the same key is a fraction. -25 is -25%.

abilities.name: Phylactery
abilities.description: Damage taken -35% for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Upon taking damage which would bring you below 10% health, become a Shade ... Reaching your Phylactery in this state revives you with 40% of your maximum health'. There is no cheat-death mechanic and no world position to walk back to, so it is a heavy mitigation window instead - the thing the Shade would have bought. Both Death and Rime list a pre-placed Phylactery as one of the only things that works through a stunlock.

abilities.name: Ghoulify
abilities.description: Interrupts and stuns the target for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: Death's weakness list names "Ghoulify's fear" among the tools that need you free to act. Fear is a loss of control, so is_stun.

abilities.name: Mass Grave
abilities.description: Interrupts and stuns up to 5 targets for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Transform up to 5 nearby enemies into a ghoul, fearing them for 40 seconds (8). Only affects Humanoids.' The Humanoid restriction has no hook and is dropped; max_targets 5 keeps the real cap.

abilities.name: Unholy Frenzy
abilities.description: Haste +20, Damage dealt +15% for 3 turns.
abilities._source: The class's big offensive cooldown - five CoA talents across the three trees exist only to modify it (Study of Death, Fleshcrafting, Unstoppable Frenzy, Dominion of Frost, Giant Bones). damage_dealt_pct is the key a BUFF uses to raise outgoing damage (percent points, read in Ability._damage_multiplier); the talent-side keys spell_damage/all_damage are read through get_talent_effect only and do nothing from a buff.

abilities.name: Call of The Scourge
abilities.description: Revives a fallen ally.
abilities._source: CoA: all three spec pages list 'brings combat rez', and Animation names it: 'Call of The Scourge, an in-combat battle res'. effect_value is the percent of max health revived at, matching tinker_defibrillate.
_tuning: 21 Nov 2026: a slow cast for the turn timeline (tools/build_cast_speeds.py)

abilities._source: CoA: 'Reinvigorate your diseases, refreshing all diseases on the target enemy and copying them ... You may use this ability again within 10 sec to Infest another target'. abilities.name: Harvest Plague
abilities.description: Deals Shadow damage to the target and heals you for part of it.
abilities._source: CoA: "Harvest Plague's siphon, Plague Doctor and Plague Drinker only ever feed your own health bar" - one of only two real sustain buttons in the Death kit.
_tuning: 15 Nov 2026, class pass: ranks put on the authored line (they ran 1.45x steeper than it, biggest single-rank jump 1.14x); overall size kept. tools/fix_rank_lines.py

abilities.name: Apothecary's Cauldron
abilities.description: Haste +10 for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Apothecary's Cauldron gives the party a spell-haste raid buff and boosts your own Magic damage. That, plus Plague of Undeath's Holy-healing debuff, is the closest thing to "support" you bring.' A talent cannot reach an ally (get_talent_effect reads the caster only), so the party half is this ability and the self half is the Death talent of the same name. || target_type 'self' -> 'party', 6 Nov 2026. CoA writes this as a party/raid aura ('Increases the spell haste of all party and raid members by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects'). A TALENT EFFECT CAN NEVER REACH AN ALLY, but a party-targeted ABILITY does: abilities.py:2064 resolves target_type 'party' to all living allies and ui/screens/combat_screen.py:594 passes living_allies(); with no party context it degrades to the caster alone. Same call Kyle made for Guardian's four auras on 5 Nov 2026 and applied to Reaper's two today. The does-not-stack clause has no mechanism short of every class's equivalent aura sharing an exclusive_group, which is a project-wide decision rather than this class's.

abilities.name: Ice Barrage
abilities.description: Deals Frost damage to the target over time for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Unleash a relentless volley of glacial shards ... At the end of the duration, you entomb your target in ice, freezing them for 4 seconds.' The entomb is the is_stun; the channel is a DoT.
_tuning: 15 Nov 2026, class pass: every rank x2.08 - its total was 0.34x what a spell_dot of its level, cooldown and cast speed should total (a CoA per-tick number entered as a total?). tools/fix_weak_over_time.py

abilities.name: Glacial Impact
abilities.description: Deals Frost damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Use Glacial Impact on any Frozen target for its guaranteed crit (Glacier Lord)'. The Frozen requirement has no engine state to check - there is no Frozen flag - so it is castable always and the Frozen-only payoffs (Glacier Lord, Frigidness) are unconditional crit talents instead. The spec's biggest single hit.
_tuning: 15 Nov 2026, class pass: ranks put on the authored line (they ran 1.45x steeper than it, biggest single-rank jump 1.14x); overall size kept. tools/fix_rank_lines.py

abilities.name: Command: Bonefreeze
abilities.description: Interrupts and stuns up to 5 targets for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Command your Skeletal Mages to freeze enemies at target location for 40 seconds (8 sec vs players). Damage taken may end the effect.' The group peel Rime opens packs with.

abilities.name: Lich Form
abilities.description: Frost Spell Power +50, Magic Resistance +30.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Lich Form is the Undead-transform become-the-Lich cooldown ... increasing your Frost damage dealt by 10%. While active you generate 3 Runic Power every 5 sec.' frost_spell_power is read by Character.get_effective_spell_power, so this really does only scale Frost. The passive Runic Power tick has no hook - no engine path grants a resource per turn from a buff. Duration 0 and an exclusive_group make it a stance.
_tuning: 16 Nov 2026, support pass: a rank every 10 levels to 58 (tools/regrade_buff_ranks.py); its flat stats are sized from each rank's level (combat/support_formula.py)

abilities._source: CoA: '"Support" here means Chilling Presence for the party crit aura' - 'Increases critical strike chance of all party and raid members by 3%'. Party-scoped for the same reason Apothecary's Cauldron is. || target_type 'self' -> 'party', 6 Nov 2026. CoA writes this as a party/raid aura ('Increases the critical strike chance of all party and raid members by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects'). A TALENT EFFECT CAN NEVER REACH AN ALLY, but a party-targeted ABILITY does: abilities.py:2064 resolves target_type 'party' to all living allies and ui/screens/combat_screen.py:594 passes living_allies(); with no party context it degrades to the caster alone. Same call Kyle made for Guardian's four auras on 5 Nov 2026 and applied to Reaper's two today. The does-not-stack clause has no mechanism short of every class's equivalent aura sharing an exclusive_group, which is a project-wide decision rather than this class's.

abilities.name: Animate: Frost Wyrm
abilities.description: Deals Frost damage to up to 5 targets over time for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Animate a Frost Wyrm that flies behind the Necromancer that blasts nearby enemies every 2 sec for 30 seconds'. NOT a summon_pet: effect_type 'summon' does nothing, the engine only handles 'summon_pet' with a summon_pet_template that already exists in combat/pet_templates.py, and there is no frost-wyrm template (nor may one be added). A pet whose only job is to tick AoE damage on a timer IS a persistent AoE DoT, so that is what it is - the honest version, rather than the four Tinker abilities that shipped as 'summon' and summoned nothing for months.
_tuning: 15 Nov 2026, class pass: ranks put on the authored line (they ran 1.48x steeper than it, biggest single-rank jump 1.19x); overall size kept. tools/fix_rank_lines.py

abilities.name: Raise: Ghoul
abilities.description: Summons a pet to fight for you.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Raise a Ghoul to aid you in combat occupying 1 Life Force. Its auto attacks restore SP health to you. Command: Expels leeching plague that strikes up to 5 nearby enemies, dealing Intellect Plague damage, and healing you for Intellect for each Ghoul.' NOW A REAL GHOUL. This was 'wolf' and summoned a pet named Wolf - the old note here recorded that as a deliberate mapping because 'no undead pet template exists and none may be added'. Both halves of that have since changed: multi-pet support landed (Character.EXTRA_PET_CAP gives Necromancer 3 pets beyond active_pet, hence additional_pet below), which stood Wolf, Imp, Succubus and Faceless Destroyer on the field together, and combat/pet_templates.py now carries a real 'ghoul' - melee, level_req 8 to match this ability, with its CoA leech implemented as a damage_and_heal that genuinely smart-heals the owner's lowest-health party member. The 5-target Command plague is still not expressible (pet AoE is dead in both directions - see that file's SUMMON_THEME_SOURCE), and the Animation tree's Vampiric Aura talent still carries its own on-hit leech separately.
_tuning: 21 Nov 2026: a slow cast for the turn timeline (tools/build_cast_speeds.py)

abilities.name: Raise: Skeletal Mage
abilities.description: Summons a pet to fight for you.
abilities._source: CoA Rime: 'Raise a Skeletal Mage to aid you in combat, occupying 2 Life Force. Command: Unleashes ice at your target and enemies within 6 yds, dealing frost SP Frost damage'. NOW A REAL SKELETAL MAGE. This was 'imp' and summoned a pet named Imp with Firebolt - the right SHAPE (base_attack 0, real base_spell_power, one nuke) and the wrong name, wrong school and wrong class's numbers. combat/pet_templates.py now carries 'skeletal_mage', a Frost caster at level_req 14 to match this ability. Rime's rotation opens with 'Raise a Skeletal Mage first', which is why it is the earliest caster pet. The Command's 6-yard splash is not expressible.
_tuning: 21 Nov 2026: a slow cast for the turn timeline (tools/build_cast_speeds.py)

abilities.name: Raise: Banshee
abilities.description: Summons a pet to fight for you.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Raise a Banshee to aid you in combat, occupying 2 Life Force. It will channel on your target, dealing damage and draining their mana over time. Command: Drains 20% of your target's mana ... and deals Frost damage equal to the mana drained'. NOW A REAL BANSHEE. This was 'succubus' and summoned a pet named Succubus casting Lash of Pain and Seduction - a Warlock demon on a Necromancer. combat/pet_templates.py now carries 'banshee' at level_req 20 to match this ability: Shadow wail plus a Frost Mana Siphon (damage_and_restore_mana). The TARGET-SIDE drain still has no hook - nothing in this engine reduces an enemy's resource pool - so the siphon refills the Banshee, not the Necromancer; that limit is written out in the template's own _source.
_tuning: 21 Nov 2026: a slow cast for the turn timeline (tools/build_cast_speeds.py)

abilities.name: Raise: Abomination
abilities.description: Summons a pet to fight for you.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Raise an Abomination to aid you in combat, occupying 3 Life Force. It is surrounded by a disease cloud, dealing SP Nature damage to enemies when they deal damage and reducing their attack speed by 20% for 15 seconds'. NOW A REAL ABOMINATION. This was 'faceless_destroyer' and summoned the Cultist's pet - picked at the time for being the toughest melee template in the roster, which is the right instinct for a 3-Life-Force raise and the wrong creature. combat/pet_templates.py now carries 'abomination' at level_req 30 to match this ability: the slowest, most armoured of the four raises, with a real Nature Disease Cloud. The cloud's AREA and the -20% attack speed are still not expressible on a pet (a pet never casts a debuff, and pet AoE is dead); Animation's Flesh Symbiosis talent still carries the per-Abomination armour.
_tuning: 21 Nov 2026: a slow cast for the turn timeline (tools/build_cast_speeds.py)

abilities.description: Deals Shadow damage to up to 4 targets.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Dump generated RP into Animate: Skeletal Archers for instant ranged bodies' - 'Animate 3 Skeletal Archers to aid you in combat for 15 seconds'. Three bodies at once cannot be pets: active_pet holds exactly one, and there is no archer template. A 15-second volley of ranged undead is AoE damage, so that is what it is.

abilities.name: Animate: Tomb King
abilities.description: Damage dealt +12%, Attack Power +40 for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Keep Tomb King up so every minion attack hits harder' - 'all of your Undead minion's attacks deal an additional 10% of the damage dealt as Plague damage'. A Pet reads only three talent keys off its owner (pet_damage/pet_health/pet_armor, see entities/pet.py) and nothing at all off the owner's buffs, so a buff cannot reach a minion. This raises the Necromancer's own damage instead and the tree's pet_damage nodes carry the minion half.
_tuning: 16 Nov 2026, support pass: a rank every 10 levels to 58 (tools/regrade_buff_ranks.py); its flat stats are sized from each rank's level (combat/support_formula.py)
